canonical_evidence_protocol.permitted_canonical_read: only the assigned core and context ranges
canonical_evidence_protocol.quote_rule: each quote must occur after whitespace normalization within the exact canonical line_start through line_end
canonical_evidence_protocol.path_rule: document_path must exactly equal the assigned canonical document_path
canonical_evidence_protocol.range_rule: line_start and line_end must be wholly contained in one assigned core or context range
canonical_evidence_protocol.verification_before_submit: re-read each cited canonical line range and delete or correct any mismatched evidence ref before returning

output_rules.format: one JSON object only, with no Markdown fence or prose

evidence_shape.line_start: canonical 1-based integer within assigned core or context
evidence_shape.line_end: canonical 1-based integer within the same assigned range
evidence_shape.excerpt: nonempty exact quote from those canonical source lines

output_rules.exact_evidence_refs: deduplicated list containing every nested evidence ref
output_rules.no_finding_behavior: return an empty candidate_findings array and use explicit_non_gaps or unknowns
output_rules.repair_recommendations: forbidden beyond describing the missing or underspecified contract
output_rules.exact_reviewer_conclusions: must not be inferred or mentioned

infrastructure_failure_rule: If a required hash or byte size mismatches, return status infrastructure_failure, keep substantive arrays empty, describe only the mismatch in unknowns, and perform no semantic review.
